description: Concatenate an ordered list of video and/or still-image segments (all public HTTPS URLs) into one continuous, fresh-encoded output — the video 'splice' step. Put an image segment first for a head slate/bumper, last for a tail slate/end card, or in the middle for a mid-roll insert/cutaway — or use all-video segments to splice two or more real clips together back-to-back. Each segment is {type: 'video', url} or {type: 'image', url, duration_seconds}. Needs at least 2 segments (max 8) and at least one type 'video' segment — its resolution and frame rate become the output's defaults. Segments are scaled to fit and letterboxed (not stretched) if aspect ratios differ; any segment without audio gets a matching silent track synthesised. Output formats: mp4, webm, mov_prores. Returns a job_id — poll get_job_status until 'complete', then get_download_url.

segments.description: Ordered list of segments, played in array order. At least one must be type 'video'.

duration_seconds.description: Required for type 'image': how long the still holds, in seconds (0.5–60). Ignored for type 'video'.

url.description: Public HTTPS URL of this segment's source file.

name: conform_splice_from_url

job_id.description: Unique identifier for this job. Pass to get_job_status and get_download_url.
